answer: Each identity is issued only by sealed auction for a harbor slot, with one canyon path. A bidder locks an 80-credit bond and pays: first 33, kth 33+7(k-1), 1,000th 7,026, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,529,500 plus 80,000 locked, no discount or reuse. Each holder relays one signed whisper through its own canyon path each epoch. An auditor matches log keys to slots, burning the bond for a missed relay, reused key, or shared path. A rented-relay ring fails: one operator cannot relay distinct whispers on paths in one window without collisions. An honest agent pays 33 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
